brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.evidence: Three full hex bases at 0,0,0 + 0,1,0 + 1,0,0 forming minimal triangular cluster (3 pieces, counts piece:3) – compact footprint.

requirements.requirement: Drawer integrated in the desk unit
requirements.evidence: Notch drawer frame hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at 1,1 level 0 (ref notch:0#1,1#notch2) fills the empty cell between the two adjacent bases 0,1,0 and 1,0,0; described as drawer as wide as position allows – provides drawer function for desk.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Mount spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (ref spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 level 0) – only location where three full bases meet in this cluster – variant mount with setSpikeAccessory platform-sm attached.

finish.summary: Built compact 3-base triangle desk unit. Added notch drawer frame at 1,1 to provide drawer between the two outer bases, and a mount spike at the central 0,0|0,1|1,0 junction with small platform accessory. check_build ok true, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
